summary: Camera behaviour of the editor (free) camera; seen on camera entities in every level and in dialogues. The member boundaries come from the Toolkit's move-assignment operator, which copies member by member: 4@0, 1@4, 1@5, 1@6, 4@8, 4@0xC, 4@0x10, 1@0x14, 4@0x18, 8@0x1C, 8@0x24, 4@0x2C, 8@0x30, 4@0x38, 4@0x3C (bytes 7 and 0x15-0x17 are not copied = padding). Defaults from the macOS constructor (offsets agree with operator=). Registration bg3.exe+0x3B5CE40: size/alignment word 0x400040 (size 0x40), no destructor.

Earlier reading: ls::CameraSystem::OnInputEditorCameraBehavior (GameEngine.dll+0x62E760; the view's slot +0x50 = EditorCameraBehavior) writes +input / -input on input events 0x1B / 0x1C (one axis of camera movement); ls::EditorCameraBehavior::operator=(&&) (GameEngine.dll+0x2647D0) copies 4 bytes; macOS default 0; live 0.

fields.name: DampingLevel
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0x7D51B0 ls::EditorCameraBehavior::GetCurrentCameraMoveDamping and +0x7D51F0 GetCurrentCameraRotDamping (Toolkit exports) switch on the int at +0x3C: 0 -> s_HighSpeed{Move,Rot}Damping, 1 -> s_MediumSpeed..., 2 -> s_LowSpeed..., else s_OffSpeedDamping; the constructor +0x7D5170 writes 3 (off). Live always 3. Earlier reading: ls::EditorCameraBehavior::operator=(&&) (GameEngine.dll+0x2647D0) copies 4 bytes; macOS default 3; live always 3. The class has statics s_Off/Low/Medium/HighSpeed{Move,Rot}Damping (macOS names) - possibly the current speed level.
